next.reason: A restriction is lifted and a run-time requirement became an exception condition. 1985: 'The evaluation of length must result in a positive nonzero integer' (§1985:IV.4.3.8.3.4 GR4). 2023: 'The evaluation of length shall result in a positive nonzero integer, unless the REF-MOD-ZERO-LENGTH directive is set to ON, when the result may also be zero' (§2023:8.4.3.3.4 GR5), so a zero-length reference modification is accepted; a non-integer, zero or out-of-range position or length sets EC-BOUND-REF-MOD, and with the directive off 'the exception condition EC-BOUND-REF-MOD is raised' for zero length (§2023:7.3.23.3 GR1). Leftmost position, sum rule and omitted length are otherwise the same. This confirms the constructs.json ref-mod-zero-length-2023 gate. GR-8.4.3.3.4-1 (position kinds) states none of this rule.
